capabilities: Add, edit, and delete comments on files and folders via right-click
Show comment tooltips when hovering items in the File Explorer
Display the active note's comment in the status bar
Rename, move, and delete comment entries automatically when files change
disambiguation: Adds comments to files and folders shown in the File Explorer, not comments inside note content.
extras: Desktop only (Windows primary, macOS/Linux less validated), mobile unsupported, requires Obsidian 1.14.4+; not yet in the community plugin store, so manual installation from GitHub Releases is needed.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to attach descriptions to arbitrary files, attachments, or folders that are visible at a glance in the File Explorer.

relations.evidence: a plain-text format used by file managers such as Total Commander

summary: Adds editable comments to files and folders in the File Explorer, stored in descript.ion files with hover tooltips and status bar display.
